scope: 22 working approved Kaz AI directions and 1 completed calculator = 23 total. The new approved direction is "внутренности настроек". Paid billing and Google account integration are excluded from this shell stage.
basis: Cross-direction fixes after adding 17 UI languages: translation targets expanded to 17; code/document helpers and calculator provide safe English fallback for other locales; interruption text corrected; browser and source regression coverage added. GitHub code saved and preview synced, syntax verified; full CI and live publishing not confirmed.
